answer: For agents certifying jade mined from a knoll, require a separate fraud bond per report. After each report is committed, an unpredictable draw selects samples for independent lab testing; a false provenance fable forfeits the bond. At a 10% audit rate and a $200 bond, a detectable fake report risks $20 in expected loss against a $5 fee. Splitting reports among 100 aliases preserves that loss per report. Bonds stay locked until audits finish, and tests must reliably detect fraud.
